[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:380YE Spring]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>To amend the title of Imperial Admiral to whit:
Title to Imperial Fleet Master<br>
Powers to address Military Council<br>
Responsibilities to drum up support for Imperial Navies from citizen's fleets<br>
Appointment by vote of military council.<br>
<i>Proposed by Sarvos, Seconded by Weirwater</i></ic> 

===Overview===
* This motion followed on from the previous motion to create the title, which passed in Spring 378YE.
* This motion amended the Imperial title of Imperial Admiral, which is now known as [[Imperial Fleet Master]].
* Passed

===Date===
* Spring 380YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The [[Imperial Title]] of Imperial Admiral has been altered, and is now known as [[Imperial Fleet Master]].
